title: Design Trends: Interior & Exterior Projects | GenStone
description: Adding faux stone to the interior or exterior your home or business is one of the hottest design trends. It's green, easy to install and affordable.
text:
Trends and Ideas for Faux Stone Projects
New and emerging ways to improve your home this year

Today's Popular Interior and Exterior Design ideas

Faux stone projects are a great way to update the look of your home or business. The versatility ofÂ stone veneer panels can also offer a modern, rustic element to your home’s interior design as well. The look of stone, tile and wood is becoming more popular with design professionals as well as DIYers because of its affordable and practical ability to transform any dull space into a memorable experience. Here are some on-trend interior design ideas using the versatility of faux stone.

Bar Top and Surround

One of the most popular faux stone trends involves installing the stone veneer panels around a breakfast, BBQ or spirits bar. The faux stone panels complement the granite countertop and cabinets, adding a rich, earthy feel to the space. With GenStone’s expansive collection of faux stone styles, finding the perfect blend of color and texture will give the room a cozy yet modern appeal.

Brick Accent Wall

Faux brick panels are great to add impact to an otherwise uninspiring space. Faux brick is extremely versatile and appropriate for any style room. Add elegance to a kitchen, authenticity to a living room or modernity to a bathroom. Faux brick panels are popular because of their classic appeal and timeless adaptability.

Bring a burst of color and texture which a typical white wall can’t compete with. GenStone’s faux brick panels are easier to install and maintain than real brick, making faux brick the logical choice for interior design.

Combining Textures

Natural themes are dominating interior design trends. Meshing various natural elements brings consistency and authenticity to your interior renovation vision. Bringing an outdoor feel inside. Incorporating stone veneer panels into a greater wood theme can take a room from interesting to memorable.

Be strategic about stone veneer panel installation; if wood is the primary element, be sure to use the faux stone as an accent which won’t compete with the wood. Tastefully blending these elements is key toward achieving the look without overwhelming the space.

Stone Pillars and Columns

Faux stone columns and pillars are functional, but why can’t they also be decorative? GenStone’s stacked stoneÂ pillar panel kits make it easy to add a touch of class and sophistication to columns. Pillars and columns add elegance and prestige to your space, while adding faux stone or brick only enhances the prominence of your interior design.

Faux stone projects are only increasing in popularity as designers and consumers realize the impact of the high-quality, low-cost products on their properties.
